result.content:
# Proposed discovery plan

Determine whether to develop and launch a dedicated handoff tracker tailored for small software development teams in Latvia.

## Proposed scope

- Investigation of cross-functional and sprint handoff workflows in small software teams located in Latvia
- Evaluation of handoff tracking pain points, tooling overhead, and integration requirements
- Exclusion of payroll management, accounting, and financial advice capabilities

Region: Latvia

Explicit exclusions: Do not include payroll or financial advice

## Engineering Lead

Oversees development sprint handoffs, task assignments, and routine developer synchronization in small teams.

- How many hours per week does your team spend compiling and copying status updates across handoffs? (question-f98ee09440ba06a1e04df4e5)
- Which project tracking and messaging tools must a handoff tool integrate with to avoid disrupting your existing workflow? (question-c92bb26c0da01f75094b61bb)

## Operations / Delivery Manager

Responsible for delivery continuity, resource allocation, and operational tooling purchases.

- What criteria or quantifiable time savings would justify purchasing a standalone handoff tracking solution for your team? (question-021ff7453a02ad516eb38b64)

## Simulation hypotheses

- We spend two hours copying handoff updates each Friday. [source:operator-interview]

## Assumptions

- Small software engineering teams in Latvia experience manual consolidation overhead when synchronizing weekly or sprint updates.
- The synthetic interview fixture reflects an illustrative workflow challenge rather than verified market-wide empirical practice.

## Evidence gaps

- Empirical data on software company density, typical team size, and existing handoff workflows in Latvia.
- Validated market data regarding software tooling budgets and willingness to pay among Latvian technology businesses.
- No non-synthetic source findings were established; the plan is a proposal, not customer validation.

This scope is proposed, not a claim of user approval.

## Selected sources

- [source:operator-interview] Synthetic operator interview fixture — synthetic_transcript
